segments.name: Investment portfolio
segments.description: Invests primarily in corporate debt securities and CLO structured finance investments to maximize total return.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating and reporting segment and its primary business objective is to maximize its investment portfolio's total return.

revenueModel.text: Portfolio companies pay the company interest on the corporate debt securities it holds.
revenueModel.evidence: Interest payments, if not deferred, are normally payable quarterly with most debt investments having scheduled principal payments on a monthly or quarterly basis.
